title: Memory Pairs
prompt:
Build a memory pairs game: 16 cards in a 4x4 grid (index = row * 4 + col) holding 8 pairs of faces 0-7, shuffled with the seeded PRNG and drawn as distinct symbols. Flipping a face-down card shows it; the second card of an attempt adds one move: equal faces become 'matched' (+10 score), different faces stay up for 45 ticks and then turn face down, and other flips are ignored meanwhile. Flipping a card that is already up or matched is ignored. Matching all 8 pairs ends the game. Click or tap a card to flip it. Show moves, score and a short win screen.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, moves, matched (pairs found), cards:[{state:'down'|'up'|'matched'}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.flip(i): returns false when ignored
- Game.cardCenter(i): canvas point of card i
- Game.debug.faces(): the 16 face values

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): dealing, flips, matches, mismatches turning back, completion, seeded layouts, click and tap.
